revenue.source: FY2024/FY2025: AB InBev FY25 results release (BusinessWire 12 Feb 2026; SEC 6-K 0001193125-26-049841). FY2023: not found.

operating_income.source: Reported profit from operations FY2024 15,487 / FY2025 15,405 (FY25 results release). FY2023 not found.

d_and_a.source: Reported EBITDA less profit from operations (FY25: 21,057-15,405; FY24: 21,031-15,487), incl. impairment; 6-K 0001193125-26-049841. FY2023 not found.

capex.source: Gross acquisition of PP&E and intangibles, cash flow statement, 6-K 0001193125-26-049841. FY2023 not found.

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY25 revenue fell ~0.7% reported while organic growth was ~2%; assume low-single-digit pricing/mix-led growth fading to 3%.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY25 reported margin 26.0%, normalized 26.7%; hold ~26.5%.

da_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY25 D&A/revenue 9.5%; slight decline as net capex is optimised.

capex_pct_revenue.source: Company guidance net capex USD 3.5-4.0bn for FY26 (~6.3% of revenue at midpoint); FY25 gross 6.5%.

wacc.source: Assumption: staples brewer, beta ~0.85, rf ~4.3%, ERP ~5%, pre-tax cost of debt ~4% (company guidance), ~25% debt weight.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: long-run inflation-like growth for mature beer category.

net_debt.source: Company-reported net debt USD 60.9bn at 31 Dec 2025 (FY25 results release). CAVEAT: company definition includes lease liabilities; split not found, so may overstate vs exclude-leases convention.

diluted_shares.source: Yahoo Finance (ABI.BR) diluted average shares ~2,016m FY2025; column alignment uncertain, not verified against 6-K.
